perItemFindings.label: S2
perItemFindings.one_line: `IIDSample` is correctly measure-valued, but the proposed `cellMeasure W` cannot obtain its PMF unit-mass proof from `FourWaveLaw.mass_simplex` alone: `FourWaveLaw` permits illegal observed paths, while only `Consistency` plus `AbsorbingExit`/`FaceModel` makes every positive-mass observed atom land in `Cell m`.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan S2/`ass:iid-panels`/`Helpers/Sampling.lean`: make `cellLaw` and `cellMeasure` carry a legality witness (or a `FaceModel W KS` binder), and derive the cell-simplex/unit-mass fact from that witness before constructing `PMF.ofFintype`. As written, filtering/pushing arbitrary `FullAtom.observed` values to absorption-legal cells can lose mass, so the claimed `cellMeasure W : Measure (Cell m)` probability instance—and hence the `IIDSample` reuse—is not sound.
